title: Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Rate Schedule for the Settlement Restocking Fee
content:
Co-brand card rate schedule for the settlement restocking fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on a changed-mind return of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership. The rate turns on the member's Northgate Credit Cards signature card and the Northgate purchases charged to it.

## Card rate for the settlement restocking fee

When the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Signature or Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus and the Northgate purchases on that card's statements of the last 12 months total 6000.00 or more, the rate is 10 percent; when the member holds such an active card and those purchases total at least 2000.00 but less than 6000.00, the rate is 12.5 percent; otherwise the rate is the channel's own restocking fee percentage.

The card is the member's Northgate Credit Cards account in status active; the purchases counted are the qualifying spend in the Northgate purchases category on that card's statement reward entries dated within the last 12 months.

| Active card held | Northgate purchases on its statements, last 12 months (USD) | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature or Signature Plus | 6000.00 or more | 10 percent |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature or Signature Plus | at least 2000.00, less than 6000.00 | 12.5 percent |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature or Signature Plus | less than 2000.00 | the channel's own restocking fee percentage |
| no active signature card | any amount | the channel's own restocking fee percentage |

## Thresholds on both sides (hypothetical histories)

| Last 12 months | Rate with an active Northgate Rewards Visa Signature |
|---|---|
| 6000.00 | 10 percent |
| 5999.99 | 12.5 percent |
| 2000.00 | 12.5 percent |
| 1999.99 | the channel's own restocking fee percentage |
